coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Which MITRE ATT&CK techniques your detecting products caught, and which they missed, from the tests you have run.
coverage.byTacticDetail: Each tested technique counts once, by its latest outcome.
coverage.noTacticsDetail: Start a run under Runs to see coverage build up here.
coverage.gapsTitle: {n} techniques ran and nothing caught them
coverage.noneDetail: Techniques appear here after a run.

runs.title: Runs
runs.pageDetail: Each run plays the chosen tests on one allowed host, tags every step with a run id, and checks whether a detecting product saw it.
runs.noneDetail: Start a run above to validate detection.
runs.startDetail: Pick an allowed host and the tests to run. The agent runs each test from its own built-in pack.
runs.name: Name
runs.noAllowed: No host is allowed for simulation
runs.noAllowedDetail: Allow a host under Hosts, with a reason, before you can run tests on it.

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: The fixed, reviewed pack of harmless tests. A run can only choose from these; the pack is code, not data.
tests.safeDetail: The server names a test by its id; the agent runs it from its own built-in pack and refuses anything else. Every test cleans up after itself. No credential dumping, no persistence, no privilege escalation and no network scanning.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.pageDetail: Hosts with the agent. A host runs nothing until an admin allows it for simulation, with a reason.
hosts.gateTitle: A host is attacked only once you allow it
hosts.gateDetail: Enrolment is read-only. Allowing a host, with a reason, is the opt-in; it is written to the audit log and can be paused at any time.
hosts.noneDetail: Install the agent on a host and enrol it with a token.
hosts.allowDetail: This host will run the harmless tests of any run you start on it. Say why it is safe to attack; this is recorded.
hosts.reasonPlaceholder: Staging host owned by the security team, no customer data
hosts.removeDetail: The agent's secret ends at once. Its runs and steps stay under its name.
hosts.tokensDetail: An agent trades a token once for its own secret. For one host, or more uses for a fleet.
hosts.maxUsesHint: 1 for one host, more for a fleet
hosts.tokenOnce: Copy this token now; it is shown once

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: Install the agent on a host, allow the host, and point the server at your detecting products.
setup.agentDetail: On the host you want to test. Make an enrolment token under Hosts first.
setup.allowDetail: Under Hosts, allow the host for simulation with a reason. Until then it runs nothing.
setup.detectorsDetail: Give the server a read-only token for SIEM and Runtime so it can check whether a test was detected (ADR 0023).

settingsPage.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this product to change these settings.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile, password and second factor.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who can sign in to Attack Simulation, and their roles.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.description: Local accounts and your identity provider.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Tokens for scripts, each with one role and an expiry.
